chunks: The sorcerers fell to the ground in homage,
ai.seo_question: What happened to Pharaoh's magicians when they saw Musa's miracle?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this moment marks the transition of the magicians from professional skeptics to sincere believers, illustrating that true faith arises from witnessing divine power rather than mere intellectual assent. Their prostration serves as a foil to Pharaoh's stubbornness, emphasizing the theme of *tawhid* (monotheism) prevailing over worldly authority. This event is often cited to highlight the immediacy of recognition (*ma'rifah*) when the veil of illusion is lifted.
